India Seeks DNA Samples for Flood Victims in Nepal

India is seeking DNA samples from families of its nationals missing in Nepal following devastating floods. The Indian Embassy in China is coordinating this effort to identify victims. The process involves collecting samples from relatives to match with potential victims found in Nepal. This measure aims to facilitate the identification and repatriation of Indian citizens affected by the natural disaster.
